new.text: Specification of Diagnostics AUTOSAR AP R25-11 [SWS_DM_00814] Providing the PowerMode in DoIP protocol messages Upstream requirements: RS_Diag_00026, RS_Diag_00080 ⌈ If the DM needs to know the PowerMode to be able to react or answer on any DoIP message, it shall obtain it, by calling the method ara::diag::DoIPPowerMode:: GetDoIPPowerMode . ⌋ [SWS_DM_01525] ara::diag::DoIPPowerMode not yet offered when client re- quests DoIP PowerMode Upstream requirements: RS_Diag_00080 ⌈ If a client requests the DoIP power mode information, the DM shall send a DoIP power mode information response with power mode value 0 ("Not ready"), as long as the Offer function of the ara::diag::DoIPPowerMode interface is not called yet by the Adaptive Application, that provides it (as defined in the ISO 13400-2[2] specification). ⌋ [SWS_DM_00813] Providing the GID in DoIP protocol messages using applica- tion interface Upstream requirements: RS_Diag_00026 ⌈ If DoIpInstantiation.gid is not configured, then DM shall obtain the GID by calling the method ara::diag::DoIPGroupIdentification::GetGidStatus . ⌋ [SWS_DM_02008] Providing the GID if application interface not available Upstream requirements: RS_Diag_00026 ⌈ If DM fails to obtain the GID according to [SWS_DM_00813], then DM shall send the GID with invalidity pattern with value as "0xFF 0xFF 0xFF 0xFF 0xFF 0xFF". ⌋ [SWS_DM_02009] Providing the GID using configured value Upstream requirements: RS_Diag_00026 ⌈ If DoIpInstantiation.gid is configured, then DM shall send the GID with value as configured in DoIpInstantiation.gid . ⌋ [SWS_DM_02107] Vehicle Announcement/Identification Response Message with- out " VIN / GID sync status" byte Upstream requirements: RS_Diag_00026 ⌈ If DoIpNetworkConfiguration.vehicleIdentificationSyncStatus is not configured or set to false, the DM shall send the Vehicle Announcement/Identification Response Message without the optional " VIN /GID sync status" parameter. ⌋ [SWS_DM_02010] Vehicle Announcement/Identification Response Message with " VIN / GID sync status" byte Upstream requirements: RS_Diag_00026 ⌈ If DoIpNetworkConfiguration.vehicleIdentificationSyncStatus is set to true, the DM shall provide the " VIN /GID sync status" according to ISO 13400- 2[2][3]. ⌋ 105 of 1171 Document ID 723:
